name: Kotaemon
description: Clean, customisable RAG web UI for chatting with your own documents, usable by end users and pipeline developers.
whatItDoes: Lets users upload documents and ask questions with cited answers, and gives developers a base for building their own RAG pipelines. It supports local and API-based models.
howItWorks: A Gradio application wraps indexing and retrieval pipelines, with optional GraphRAG indexing and reasoning strategies for complex questions. Docker images come in full, lite and Ollama-bundled variants, or the app can be run from source with uv.
models: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Ollama and other local models
